priority_items.title: PMMM-4 reception closed; Matangi reports 15 Sep opening; Matatoa still unpublished
priority_items.summary: Programmed sitting and Likualofa reception (to 08:00 UTC) have elapsed. Matangi Tonga (21:25 TOT / 08:25 UTC) carries Crown Prince Tupoutoʻa ʻUlukalala’s 15 Sep opening call to sustain Pacific weather systems. pacificmet.net remains programme-plus-draft. PACNEWS 16 Sep still treats PMMM-4 as forthcoming. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: PNG 51st Independence omits Panguna; Goroka 17-escape now dated; Enga 32 arrests
priority_items.summary: Independence Hill copy is work/discipline/education; PMNEC still has no transcript; visible speech still omits Panguna/Lloyds. NBC (14:51 PGT) confirms 17 escaped Goroka cells Monday 14 Sep; 8 recaptured, 9 at large. Enga Acting PPC (18:34 PGT / 08:34 UTC) reports 32 Independence-week summary arrests. Provincial L&O, not FLASH. Panguna fatalities remain PNG-media CLAIM; no BPS SITREP.

priority_items.title: Vanuatu Matui SAR continues; complaint still request-only; China US$100k is cash not a pact
priority_items.summary: Confirmed toll band unchanged: 2 dead / 14 survivors / ~30+ missing. VMSA criminal complaint lodged; Napuati wants Master arrested under Penal Code s.108 — Daily Post still request-only. VFSC has no Tui extract. Banx 'captain in custody' is Tier C. China US$100k / VT11m handed over 15 Sep for Ambae + Matui. Napat cancelled UNGA. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: Fiji HIV national emergency still ministerial; gazette missing
priority_items.summary: Lalabalavu 15 Sep declared a national emergency (~1 in 60 adults vs 1 in 167 five years ago). fiji.gov.fj 16 Sep news list has no s.69 PHA 1935 Legal Notice. Needle-programme legislation flagged for next sitting under SO 51. Partners named: AUS, NZL, Global Fund, IND, UN. Not a security pact.

priority_items.title: Wale UNGA travel notice; AUS–SLB still unsigned; East Makira unchanged
priority_items.summary: PMO: PM Matthew Wale departs 16 Sep for UNGA-81. No SIBC/airport wheels-up (SIBC Cloudflare). DFAT pages still show 3 Jun 'commence negotiations.' East Makira RNZ copy unchanged. GREAT climate bills remain intent. Travel ≠ treaty signature.

priority_items.title: Tuvalu–Taiwan Panapa–Lai meeting is a reaffirmation, not a switch
priority_items.summary: FM Panapa met President Lai in Taipei 15 Sep. Official readout names the Kaitasi Treaty, 47th anniversary on 19 Sep, and already-signed 2026 milkfish/clean-energy work. Funafuti MFA still silent. Pacific recognisers remain TUV, PLW, MHL. Not FLASH.
